archetype: Landing Page: 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with Neon hints. Dashboard: 1 (Organic & Earthy)

rules: Do not exceed text-6xl for the H1 hero heading.
Use Noto Sans for its excellent Hindi/Gujarati script support.
Never center headings by default; align left for density, center only for hero or specific focal points.

visual_enhancers.landing_page_surfaces: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 with 1px border-white/10. Glows: shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(22,163,74,0.15)].
visual_enhancers.dashboard_surfaces: Solid clean backgrounds with max 8px radius. shadow-sm. Minimalistic and high-contrast.
visual_enhancers.3d_scene_requirements: R3F scene: AmbientLight + DirectionalLight. Floating gold coins (mesh, metalness 0.8, roughness 0.2). Glowing 3D Shield with 'GST' text (mesh, emissive #16a34a, bloom effect). Particles using Drei <Sparkles>. Canvas must be absolute behind content with pointer-events-none if not interactive.

layout_and_spacing.landing_page: Generous spacing (py-24 to py-32). Bento grid for features (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, wide gaps).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Control room layout. Dense, functional grids (gap-4, p-6). Sidebar nav.

motion_and_interactions.hero: GSAP + R3F. Continuous slow rotation of the shield. Coins raining slowly (y-axis translation).
motion_and_interactions.cards: Framer motion 3D tilt effect on pricing cards (rotateX/Y on mousemove).
motion_and_interactions.testimonials: Infinite scroll using react-fast-marquee. Very slow, organic drift.
motion_and_interactions.general: Smooth scrolling with Lenis is highly recommended for the premium feel.

components.landing_page: Pure HTML/Tailwind + Framer Motion. DO NOT use Shadcn cards/sections. Ensure full control over glassmorphism and bento grids. Use Lucide React for icons.
components.dashboard: Shadcn UI (Sidebar, Tables, Cards, Avatar, Dialog, Button, Input, DropdownMenu). Customize to white/green theme.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients/glass has drop-shadow for contrast. Use APCA contrast minimums.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-trial-button', data-testid='chat-input-field').

hero_fallback.description: Abstract dark green and gold luxury digital background for fallback if 3D context is lost or loading.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize React with Tailwind. Install @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, framer-motion, gsap, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, and @radix-ui/react-icons.

2. Landing Page: Build a dark theme '₹10 Lakh' premium page. Hero needs an absolute R3F canvas covering 100vh with a glowing green shield and floating gold coins. Add green accents (#16a34a) to text and CTA buttons (Start Free Trial with pulsing glow).

3. Features Section: Build a bento grid using pure Tailwind. Style it with glassmorphism (`bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`). Add a floating WhatsApp button fixed at the bottom right.
4. Pricing Section: Implement 3 pricing cards using Framer Motion to create a 3D tilt effect on mouse hover.
5. Dashboard: Implement a strict Light Theme with a sidebar. Use Shadcn components heavily (Sidebar, Cards, Table). Keep it pristine, authoritative, and data-focused.
6. AI Chat: Place the GST advisor chatbot centrally in the client dashboard. Show a 'Welcome' message and a 'Free questions counter' (10/10). Include distinct user/AI message bubbles.
7. Typography: Include 'Outfit' (for English Headings) and 'Noto Sans' (for Body and complete Hindi/Gujarati support) via Google Fonts.
8. Testing: Ensure EVERY button, form input, and key link includes a semantic `data-testid` attribute for testing.
9. DO NOT use placeholder images. Use the precise image URLs provided in the media section of this JSON.
